answer: Random peer audit stops sybil farming by forcing every new identity to face surprise review. Each epoch, a public atlas of agents is shuffled and each identity gets five random auditors who check real work done. Joining costs a 10 POA bond per identity, so 1,000 fakes lock 10,000 POA while one honest agent pays only 10. Auditors approving a fake lose their bond, so bad identities get ground down like a glacier, and the garden of real participants is never diluted by fakes.
